1.explanation: In this minimal React app we import Carbon’s Pagination component, turn on the pagesUnknown prop, and wire up a simple state hook so that changing pages via the select menu updates the component’s controlled page and pageSize values. When you run this code, you’ll see the same page number both in the select dropdown and again in the “page X” text — exactly the redundant behavior described in the bug report.
1.bug_scenario: When you render the Carbon Pagination component with the pagesUnknown flag set to true, the current page number appears twice in the UI — once as the selected option inside the drop-down, and once again in the adjacent “page X” text. As you change pages via the select menu, both the select’s visible value and the “page X” label update in lock-step, leading to a redundant display.
